span.p:
Validate finite float & plausibility_problem()
(Rejects <= 0, > 50 count, > 5000 g/ml)

span.p:
Tokenize query -> qwords
Build exact_vocab from all DB keys & aliases

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Iterate all (key, entry) in db and alias in entry.aliases
For each alias word w: _matched_query_word(w, qwords, exact_vocab)
1. w in qwords -> exact match
2. len >= 4, q[0] == w[0], q not in exact_vocab, SequenceMatcher >= 0.80 -> fuzzy match

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Select alias maximizing score = (len(awords), len(alias))
Compute leftover_words = qwords - best_matched - FILLER_WORDS - digits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
(key is None OR leftover_words)
AND allow_external
AND external_enabled()?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
lookup_external_food(food_text)
1. Check _CACHE (LRU 500) & _IN_FLIGHT dedup
2. Query USDA FDC (/foods/search, _name_matches)
3. Fallback Open Food Facts (v2 + CGI, reject derivatives)
4. Tag provenance ('usda_fdc' / 'open_food_facts'), never save to disk

span.p:

Clear leftover_words

Return _fail('unknown_food', did_you_mean=suggestions)
Prompts user for label macros to save as custom food

span.p:
Return _fail('low_confidence_match', closest_match=key)
Refuses to guess branded/prepared variant

span.p:
_convert(entry, name, quantity, unit)
• Resolve household_unit via entry.portions{}
• Piece/slice/scoop vs weight/volume compatibility
• Convert kg->1000g, l->1000ml, cup->240ml, tbsp->15ml, tsp->5ml
